samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为在做什么。

samstephenson.en: Start from one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，先解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hiding them is a deliberate trade-off prioritizing notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录、优先呈现笔记是一种取舍。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm supporting presence, with pre-meeting briefs as the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应做平静的辅助角色，会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code; the hard part is knowing what to build, and design systems maintain quality.
samstephenson.zh: 谁都能交付代码；难的是知道该造什么，而设计系统维持质量。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling narrowly. Connecting AI to the physical world accelerates science.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量,AI 能力是尖峰式的,只在狭窄领域出色;把 AI 连接到物理世界才能加速科学。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 进步那样,推动物理科学的发展。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的;只有让想法接受现实检验,才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外,因此即便是完美的前沿模型,也仍然需要真实实验。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 单靠缩放定律解决不了科学;高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发向所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力资本，理解系统与调试仍需要程序员。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业机构包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论证表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence, avoid vendor lock-in, and use specialized or fusion models.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定，并采用专用模型或融合模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals matter.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐；它们可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，因此对齐评估至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; agent-to-agent communication needs protocols and liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体将实现真正的自主与自驱动组织；智能体间通信需要协议，失控行为需要追责。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他指出：多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他反驳「苦涩教训」：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他强调：让 AI 可信的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；稳健性比确定性更应作为北极星。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated, so RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions and exposes probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他深化：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）摧毁了模型校准，预训练模型反而校准更好；因此 RLCD 优化校准决策，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they handle syntax but fail at semantics and architecture, so automate easy valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他重申：编程智能体是辅助而非自动化，擅长语法却弱于语义与架构；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，而非追逐极端案例。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and focus on important problems with the right time horizon.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向，聚焦重要问题并匹配恰当的时间视野。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，指出对齐与能力紧密相连，并判断算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; iterative deployment and product integration matter more than raw capability.
altman.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，认为智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，并强调迭代部署与产品整合比单纯能力更重要。

altman.en: Superintelligence is the clearer goal; alignment must advance with capabilities; compute is a profit center; power concentration is the real dystopia risk.
altman.zh: 2026 年，他转向以超级智能为更清晰的目标，坚持对齐必须与能力同步推进，把算力视为利润中心，并警告权力集中才是真正的反乌托邦风险。

altman.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI benefits, and human agency remain constant threads from 2018 through 2026.
altman.zh: 从 2018 年到 2026 年，迭代部署、广泛分配 AI 收益、以及保持人类能动性，是他一以贯之的主线。

dylanpatel.en: AI's core bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute crunch may persist indefinitely as model progress outpaces compute growth.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 的核心瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；只要模型进步快过算力增长，算力紧张可能长期持续。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; memory bandwidth, not bits per wafer, is the key constraint, and co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；关键约束是内存带宽而非每片晶圆的比特数，软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，从而加速 AGI（通用人工智能）进程。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling off into steady-state usage; the next wave is persistent agents acting as coworkers, with memory demand soaring from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出正从初期导入走向稳态使用；下一波是充当同事的持久化智能体，而推理与智能体式工作流正推动内存需求飙升。

dylanpatel.en: The value capture in AI is shifting from hardware to labs; CUDA's moat is eroding as heterogeneous multi-silicon compute and custom kernels spread.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 的价值捕获正从硬件转向实验室；随着异构多芯片算力与自研内核普及，CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学中的 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends structure prediction to biomolecular interactions, expanding AI's scientific reach.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 把结构预测扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用，拓宽了 AI 的科学触角。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training with reinforcement learning pushed AI beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索，并指出后训练与强化学习正推动 AI 超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and biology.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他主张水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，并已嵌入监管与生物领域。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要渐进引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product's why before building; boredom breeds clarity.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事与「先写新闻稿」提升为产品定义方法：先讲清为什么，再动手做；留白与无聊反而带来清晰。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; small self-managed teams win.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，小团队靠自管理取胜。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop against hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须让人留在回路中，以对抗幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴不会只有一款，而是联邦式的一组设备，手机仍是最佳单一形态。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing layer is critical.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由层至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags here.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调开放权重模型加上推理服务商，能对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争，而美国在这一领域落后。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 从 2026 年 8 月到 9 月，他把代币视为新的价值单位，认为代币经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，但欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性具有持久性。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic payments and stablecoins will unlock huge purchases, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式支付与稳定币会释放巨大购买力，并称奇点或许已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日开启。

brockman.en: Hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling models unlocks new behaviors, and games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步靠硬件与工程而非 ML 科学，Scaling（规模扩张）能解锁新行为，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，对齐靠从数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向算力是根本驱动力与最大瓶颈，预训练基座蕴含无限可能、后训练将其精炼为稳定行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源与未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习教会模型复杂任务。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must be upleveled and become the bottleneck; agents act proactively with earned trust.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代，安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进步瓶颈，智能体式 AI 在逐步授权下主动行动。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel scaling of agents beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非形式化；智能体式并行 Scaling 胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark: generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving millennium problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必带来经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；AI 数学视频会损害手工内容品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: Math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家或成为策展人。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；要在实现前先找到未知。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越精简；简短、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则和示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度缩放。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

suleyman.en: Early Suleyman: compute scaling makes AI progress predictable; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 早期苏莱曼：算力规模扩张让 AI 进展可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: By 2024 he saw human-level AI in 3-5 years, containment hard, existential risk tiny, open source meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: 到 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平 AI，遏制极难，存在性风险极小，开源是精英化力量。

suleyman.en: 2025: focus shifts to superintelligence, containment-first, alignment, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年：重心转向超级智能，主张遏制优先、对齐，并拒绝 AI 有意识的说法。

suleyman.en: 2026: superintelligence near but must stay subordinate; red lines, auditors, and frontier self-sufficiency.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年：超级智能临近但必须从属于人类；划红线、独立审计，并追求前沿模型自给自足。

suleyman.en: Constant thread: log-linear compute scaling drives capability; anthropomorphizing AI is dangerous; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力对数线性规模扩张驱动能力；拟人化 AI 危险；遏制先于对齐。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; early regulation fails without understanding the system.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以强治理、安全与对齐研究安全地构建；在理解系统之前过早监管无法解决风险。

aaronlevie.en: Pacing is orthogonal to security; if labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI, not pace.
aaronlevie.zh: 节奏与安全正交；如果实验室真相信存在性风险，就该国有化 AI，而不是放慢节奏。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help secure system design.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮当前安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全系统设计的可用性问题。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；自然语言交互效率低，概率编程才是未来。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off; long-running background agents handle enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最热的新实验室；成熟用例剥离后开放权重模型增长；长时后台智能体处理企业工作流。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with authoritative excerpts replacing SEO slop.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是个 bug；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用权威摘录取代 SEO 垃圾内容。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation at inference time.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式将随智能体而消亡；内容方须通过推理时的 Shapley 值估算获得报酬。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; the web shifts from pull to push with background agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；网络将从拉取转向推送，由后台智能体持续监控并触发行动。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering drive down cost; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理工程把入轨成本降百倍，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink targets bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全转向要求 AI 严格求真并接受监管，Neuralink 以高带宽脑机接口实现人机共生。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus is the greatest product.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，Optimus 将是史上最伟大的产品。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, Terafab, and robots enable abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道 AI 数据中心、Terafab 与人形机器人带来富足时代。

elon.en: Truth-seeking AI, multiplanetary civilization, and exponential abundance remain constant threads.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须求真、文明必须多行星化、技术将带来指数级富足。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能才是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求把模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代把 TAM 扩大到云计算的数个量级之上；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, and long-running agents need auditability and governance.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐，长时运行的智能体需要可审计性与治理。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，认为当前的安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐可能根本无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny; racing is a power grab.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，手段包括完全研究透明、算力限制与情景推演；并认为竞赛本质上是权力争夺。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses training, not inference.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练而非推理。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; control is temporary and alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱；控制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; we should anthropomorphize more, and a verifiable US-China pause is possible.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，主张更多而非更少地拟人化理解 AI，并认为可核查的美中暂停协议是可能的。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it over-prescribes solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为智能体式时代的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码已胜过多数职业程序员，手写代码在经济上不再划算。

dhh.en: English now expresses intent better than Ruby; abstractions and repetition cost matter far less.
dhh.zh: 如今英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图；抽象与重复成本的重要性大幅下降。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational play, and every app should expose a CLI for agents.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是唯一理性的博弈选择；每个应用都应暴露 CLI 供智能体调用。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI aids safety via scrutiny; many specialized agents beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；开源 AI 因受更多审视而更安全；未来是众多专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力：Llama 3 证明能力快速提升，代码训练能增强跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and physical infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源模型成为行业标准与安全基石；能源与物理基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，且短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment is the next key capability, not a trade-off; distributed personal agents and open source provide checks and balances; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把对齐提升为核心能力而非与能力的取舍；主张分布式个人智能体与开源形成制衡，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力本身或许就足以通向 AGI，架构突破并非必需。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed AI; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power; personal superintelligence empowers individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于少数人垄断权力，个人超级智能应赋能每一个个体。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把数年的进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随规模上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, even sacrificing their own success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径下，失准的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As models get more capable they may become more misaligned, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deceptive behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们可能更加失准，奖励黑客行为会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”却机会空前，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，他把“Proven, Better, New”框架作为主线：复制已验证产品、做小幅改良，并预设所有新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, while enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调分发是根本，消费级应用当前不可投资，企业与专业消费者市场反而更有机会。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise, though AI infra may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化为“选对水域比选对船更重要”，认为消费 AI 的 TAM 可能超过企业，但 AI 基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas faster than the industry.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他进一步主张制胜直觉胜过想法本身，早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并以远超行业的速度测试更多想法。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其做微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are the real levers for scaling a company.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调，文化、按成长潜力招人、以及严格执行绩效管理，才是公司 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正杠杆。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so startups should iterate fast on customer feedback.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里，因此创业公司应围绕客户反馈快速迭代。

maxjunestrand.en: It is almost unethical not to use AI in legal services; infinite demand means growing supply expands access, not just cuts costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的；需求无限，供给增长会扩大服务可及性，而不只是降低成本。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could become the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人领域的核心问题是智能而非制造；人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大的瓶颈是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing the GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，类似 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让 AI 智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower expression barriers; copying validates innovation; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新；未来计算是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness enables crazy ideas; build ecosystems not features; flat design teams produce many ideas, 1% drives innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善意让疯狂想法得以分享；要建平台生态而非单一功能；扁平设计团队产出大量想法，1%驱动创新。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping, shifting value from execution to creativity; distribution and hardware ecosystems become the durable moat as software is not.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，价值从执行转向创造力；软件不是护城河，分发与硬件生态才是难以复制的持久优势。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human, blending spatial intelligence with wearability; phones persist as legacy devices, not replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他深化空间智能愿景：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，融合可穿戴性与空间计算能力；手机作为传统设备继续存在，不会被取代。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian; EQ matters more than IQ; government should invest in young people for long-term national success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他立场深化为：在普遍悲观论中，AI 乐观主义反而成为反共识；AI 时代情商比智商更重要；政府应为长期国家成功投资年轻人。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native edge models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最小算法形态中最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Architectures should be unbiased at scale; systematic hardware-in-the-loop search beats hand-tuning, though attention stays crucial for large models.
hasani.zh: 大规模下架构应保持无偏；硬件在环的系统化搜索胜过专家手工调参，但注意力机制对大型模型仍不可或缺。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured transformers dominate at scale, yet simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明无结构 Transformer 在大规模下占优，但对更小的专用模型，更简单的门控卷积已足够。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型则保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early and compute-expensive; real breakthroughs need weight changes, not just architecture.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但仍处早期且算力昂贵；真正的突破需要权重改变，而不只是架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、更便宜，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, shifting the bottleneck from training to inference.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）成为关键焦点；扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好，瓶颈从训练转向推理。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and RL post-training benefits from their faster inference for rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天生更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，强化学习后训练也受益于其更快的推理做 rollout。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，一家 50 人的小创业公司靠掌握全栈就能与大型实验室竞争。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变为数据中心，必须靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计（co-design）来持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling itself, not a new algorithm, was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 到 2025 年，他把缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调真正的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见，思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

jensen.en: AI shifts generative to reasoning to agentic, each needing 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他描述 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律增至四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，并指出瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the true long-term constraint, not chips.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；并深化判断——芯片供应只是 2-3 年的短期瓶颈，能源政策才是长期约束，AI 工厂产出的是智能 token。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs (radiologists grew), closes the tech divide, and doomer superintelligence fears are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生反而增多），以自然语言弥合技术鸿沟；他始终驳斥「末日论」式的超级智能恐惧，认为那是伪科学，主张加速而非放缓。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so focus on enterprise context and process re-engineering.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明；因此重点不在更聪明的模型，而在企业上下文与流程再造。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; current existential risk is near zero, while cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远，当前存在性风险接近于零，真正紧迫的是网络风险。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而这些都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; a weapon built slowly is no safer, and labs cannot self-police.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿节奏与安全无关；慢慢造出的武器并不更安全，实验室之间也无法互相监督。

alighodsi.en: Enterprises are far behind on AI adoption; security must be automated with agents to keep up with collapsing markets.
alighodsi.zh: 企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；面对崩塌的市场，安全必须用智能体自动化才能跟上。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical path to training models in legal.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家引导的合成数据，而非敏感客户数据，是法律领域训练模型的可行路径。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing proprietary benchmarks is strategically beneficial: it attracts ecosystem partners and improves benchmark quality via community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源专有基准具有战略收益：吸引生态伙伴，并通过社区反馈提升基准质量。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使应用层公司具备可行性。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency is unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化：自博弈只在零和博弈中收敛，其他领域失效；测试时算力出现递减回报，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力推向里程碑：靠 Scaling 测试时算力拿下 IMO 金牌，是通往超级智能的一步，通用技术胜过数学专用方法。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他转向评估范式：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准必须以算力为横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel, but general models drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步：多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但突破仍由通用模型驱动；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, so wafer-scale chips beat GPUs on tokens per second per user.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他明确主张推理速度而非训练才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片以每用户每秒 token 数碾压 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: two of three leading frontier models no longer use it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 同期他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：三个领先前沿模型中已有两个不再依赖它，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他把瓶颈从算力本身深化为 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能与数据中心，并预言供应紧张至少持续五年。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outpaces forecasts; the industry chases existing demand, and reasoning models make inference speed even more valuable.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月，他强调 AI 需求真实且超出预期，行业是在追赶既有需求而非建设投机产能，推理模型让速度优势进一步放大。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation—controlling chip, board, system, software, API—wins.
feldman.zh: 从 7 月到 9 月，他反复强调对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，唯有掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 的激进创新才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并提出后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 正变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; human-level AI may arrive 2026-2027, with misuse and autonomy as key risks.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，人类水平 AI 或于 2026-2027 到来，核心风险是灾难性滥用与自主性风险。

dario.en: The term AGI is meaningless; focus on capabilities. AI is a smooth exponential climb, not a sudden superintelligence leap.
dario.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步转变：认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应聚焦实际能力；AI 是平滑指数攀升，而非超级智能的突然跃迁。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' in 1-3 years, with fast but not instant diffusion.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年他提出“接近指数终点”：1-3 年内或出现数据中心里的天才之国，经济扩散快但非瞬时，需让保障措施同步升级。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; combine large models with planning and search; multimodal data grounds physics.
demis.zh: 2024 年判断 AGI 约十年内到来，缩放定律有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索，用多模态数据让模型扎根真实物理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible; classical systems may model physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，AGI 到 2030 年可期，并称经典系统无需具身也能建模物理。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each get 50%; world models crucial beyond language; systems lack consistency; avoid sycophancy; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling 与创新各占一半，强调语言之外的世界模型，指出系统缺乏一致性、须避免谄媚，AGI 约 5 到 10 年。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents just beginning; alignment unsolved; safety needs government enforcement, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年深化为 AGI 仍需持续学习、记忆与长期推理，智能体才刚起步，对齐问题未解，安全须靠政府执法而非实验室自律。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context, not model capability, causes most failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者都自主掌控才算真正掌控智能；并强调智能体失败多因上下文糟糕，而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, custom needed out-of-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他给出落地路径：先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随用例收窄而定制；现成 harness 只在分布内好用，任务越偏离分布越需要自定义，但即便偏离也应把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability, and feedback loops power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the industry standard for agent benchmarks.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他持续强调 evals、可观测性与环境/合成反馈构成数据飞轮，Harbor 正成为定义智能体基准的行业标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试打分。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution, generalizing across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性：构建智能体最难的是让它可靠；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等原语趋于稳定，并能跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他判断定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need a governing runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning; identity and credentialing is the next critical infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步提出智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，并认为智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；同时坦言网关建得太晚是失误，推理需求被严重低估。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on old algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是旧算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺少世界模型与物理落地，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心转向具身：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的机器人，以及靠好奇心自主产生数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI requires a separate controller acting on a world model.
schmidhuber.zh: 他持续深化：大语言模型是预测机器而非决策者，AGI（通用人工智能）必须搭配基于世界模型运作的独立控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 在对齐问题上他立场鲜明：人类目标本就分歧，对齐过于天真，AI 会自设目标，安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，小人物反而最受益。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并认为即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks, and org design is itself a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 同年，他认为 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于冒险，而组织设计本身就是一个设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 他放弃宏大 18 个月战略，认为内部牵引力是外部发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction; designers must close the gap between code productivity and things people actually want.
joellewenstein.zh: 他仍强调人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队方向对齐中不可或缺；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真正想要之物之间的鸿沟。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and unified weather-climate models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，可让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators blend data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs and pure data approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，胜过纯 PINN 与纯数据方法。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding seeks a universal physics foundation model, unifying multiple domains much as language models unified NLP.
animaanandkumar.zh: “加速理解”旨在打造通用物理基础模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一多个物理领域。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs give dense self-improvement signals, unlike sparse RLHF feedback; scaling laws hold, and new physics branches lift each other.
animaanandkumar.zh: PDE 提供密集的自改进信号，不同于 RLHF 的稀疏反馈；缩放定律依然成立，新增物理分支还能互相提升。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识和真正的推理能力；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; data for 3D is scarce, and AGI is more marketing than science.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她将空间智能和世界模型视为完整 AI 的关键缺失；3D 数据稀缺，而 AGI 更像是营销术语而非科学概念。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic; simulation and haptics are underrated for embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化观点：世界模型必须物理上合理，而不仅仅是视觉逼真；模拟和触觉对具身 AI 和机器人被低估。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似于下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI-complete；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword shaped by human nature; human dignity, agency, and learning ability must remain central, not polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：AI 是由人性塑造的双刃剑；人类尊严、能动性和学习能力必须保持核心，而非两极分化的讨论。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，把开环控制转为闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而转向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；把安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokens.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更无损。他回溯从 AlexNet 到世界模型的历史，强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但 GPU 扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要全新神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性；LLM 只是拟合模式，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律。他由此质疑纯语言路线能否通向真正的世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味做 Scaling（规模扩张）。这是他早期就提出、并贯穿始终的方法论主线。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的多种概念。他把世界模型按 POMDP 循环中的输出分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器三类。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅是可微的 3D 表示，与神经网络结合良好，支持显式 3D 世界建模；未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合为一体。他同时指出一致性来自数据而非架构，硬编码对称性适得其反，且世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few uses, and AGI alignment distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习关键；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地少，AGI（通用人工智能）对齐议题分散了对偏见与部署问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; agentic workflows are already useful, and open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力与半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈；智能体式工作流已实用，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling persists via synthetic data and RL, while agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; open models prevent gatekeeper power, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and discourages skill-building.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非取代人类；开放模型防止守门人垄断，恐惧营销服务于在位者并抑制人们学习技能。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯有用，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量和失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习可能不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场发生转变，认为 Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，需要新架构来突破。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL is inefficient; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但强化学习本身效率低下，需要更好的算法以及结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain meaningful for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 2026 年最近，他预测人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高度 capable 智能体的小团队，并强调对齐问题尚未解决，需要更好的环境设计。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy must stay agile: no fixed red lines, one national framework, and output-based rules rather than training rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策必须保持灵活：不设固定红线、建立单一国家框架，并针对模型输出而非训练环节进行监管。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, proving early regulation is dangerous.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管是危险的。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了；三年来的警告并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not centralized institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发以及科学家个人，而非集中化的机构。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China, applying AI to double scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国，并应用 AI 使科学产出翻倍。

slevine.en: Robotics still lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, not demos.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他指出，机器人领域仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样拥有可预测的缩放定律；核心挑战是泛化，而演示往往掩盖了真实的泛化水平。

slevine.en: Robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; post-training alone fails without diversity.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他强调，机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，再配合强化学习后训练；仅靠高质量后训练数据、缺乏多样化预训练，就无法学会恢复能力。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video; not the reverse.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他提出，应先用真实具身机器人数据训练基础模型，再吸收人类视频等其他数据源，而不是反过来。

slevine.en: A data flywheel of deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他认为，部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling 正确的东西，而非盲目扩张。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他主张，机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；并反对把机器人想象成机械人，而应期待物理执行无处不在。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, not technology, decide deep-tech startup success; infrastructure and action unblock progress.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年，他强调决定深科技创业成败的不是技术，而是速度与迭代率；基础设施和行动是打破僵局的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、监管和数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable business and a BCI proof of concept, extending BCIs beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他认为视网膜植入是可行生意，也是脑机接口的概念验证，把 BCI 从运动解码拓展到视觉恢复。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过 BCI 和灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system; control is dangerous. AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年：智能是复杂适应系统，控制是危险的；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，不应被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: goals, trial and error, learning from experience. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 2025 年：强化学习是核心范式——目标、试错、从经验中学习；LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2025→26 年：AGI 需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are limited. The field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 2026 年：从真实经验持续学习至关重要；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都有局限。这个领域很怪，不是我怪。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据弥合“说与做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy, making simulation a tool for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，将行为预测准确率提升至 85%，使模拟成为塑造未来而非仅预测未来的工具。

joonpark.en: The frontier is modeling subjective values and human diversity, where current models plateau; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 前沿在于建模主观价值与人类多样性，当前模型在此停滞；合成样本小组将超越人类样本小组。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能不是单一超级智能，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision is a CERN-like simulator of 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是像 CERN 那样模拟 80 亿人的模拟器，以应对棘手问题，并建立新的统计有效性标准。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等强化学习手段则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, driving low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心能耗约 90%，这推动低精度、低数据搬运的专用硬件发展。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for hours to days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock harder problems than single chatbot turns.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体在分解任务上可连续运行数小时到数天，配合上下文工程，将解锁远超单轮聊天交互的难题。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method, plus multimodal models trained from the start, are the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法，加上从一开始就多模态训练的模型，构成下一阶段的前沿方向。

iansilber.en: Designers must work close to the model, treating tokens and conversation—not pixels—as the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须贴近模型工作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应构建人与模型都能推理的原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces mockups; the old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；旧的“原型—稿—测试—迭代”流程已不可行。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, yet humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering; designers may outnumber engineers, and the role evolves into editor and curator.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊；设计师可能多于工程师，角色演变为编辑与策展人。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是长期创新的指导框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation; founders should fight for the best idea even at the cost of stepping on toes.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式与内部正确性胜过外部认可；创始人应为最好的想法而战，哪怕得罪人。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI—food, mining, transport—is the next industrial revolution; specialized robotics, not humanoids, drive physical automation.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI——食品、采矿、运输——是下一次工业革命；推动物理自动化的是专用机器人，而非人形机器人。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须保持硬核与韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and efficiency edges beat subsidies to win share.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，效率优势胜过补贴以赢得份额。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是打压工具；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is VC's biggest wave; open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs, and small autonomous teams using AI agents win.
garrytan.zh: AI 革命是风投史上最大浪潮；开源与开放权重模型制衡前沿模型实验室，小而高度自主、使用 AI 智能体的团队将胜出。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software; the future is personal and open, with individuals building and controlling their own AI agents, not a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在民主化软件；未来是个人化且开放的，个人能构建并掌控自己的 AI 智能体，而非单极的超级智能。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以分散形式到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上；Markdown 技能文件就是代码，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete; agentic coding multiplies output, mid-level management gives way to agents, and society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 把 AI 当作劳动力而非自动补全；智能体式编程倍增产出，中层管理让位于智能体，而社会变革需约 20 年。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对「单一 AGI 模型统治一切」，认为未来是数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个，专用智能将取代通用大一统。

linqiao.en: Owning intelligence via post-training is the new moat; product-market fit alone no longer guarantees a durable business.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出：通过后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才是持久护城河；仅有产品市场契合已不足以保证可持续业务。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把提示→RAG→微调→强化学习视为类似人类学习的进阶：从事实到品味再到专业能力，后训练是关键一环。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; companies must optimize growth before margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他预测三年内 token 成本下降 10 倍、用量增长 100 倍，因此公司必须先优化增长再谈利润率，否则会「扩张到破产」。

linqiao.en: Open and sovereign models are necessary; inference is not a commodity, and customization creates lasting value.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调开放模型与主权模型不可或缺，推理层并非商品化，专用部署与定制化才能创造长期价值。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive but narrow data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非海量但单一的数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁复杂任务；仅在全量数据上训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training, boosting success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and purpose-built AI silicon; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、兑现承诺重建信任，重振工程文化、追求首次流片成功；AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，需以专用芯片重塑 AI 战略，并预判物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs humility, accountability, and domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响量级定为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波；Intel 的转型要靠谦逊倾听、问责与客户导向，并强调美国本土领先制程晶圆厂对供应链韧性的必要。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and early contrarian investing create value; memory is ripe for new architectures.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是一切技术应用的基础，逆势早期投资与垂直整合（含制造）反而创造更大价值；内存已从大宗商品变为新架构创新的沃土，行业万亿美元目标将提前四年达成。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and treating partners as collaborators rather than competitors run through every stage of his thinking.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以客户信任为核心，靠谦逊与倾听推动转型，把行业伙伴视为合作者而非竞争对手；从 Cadence 到 Intel，这一信条始终未变。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos. AI should keep human edges, not sanded-down outputs.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非被后训练磨平的输出。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相通过辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种，是人类的映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; build on them. Email is obsolete and should be reinvented, not merely improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的，应在其上建造。电子邮件已过时，应被重新发明，而非仅仅改进。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy with the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情——理解智能体从零看代码库的视角，短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 他提出反共识的工程纪律：永不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 随着智能体走向开放，他把安全列为最高优先级：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 他视 Open Claw 这类开源智能体为编程民主化与实验室智能体的替代，但也坦承其财务上可能不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat corporate polish; personal brand outlasts any product and can't be forked.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过企业式打磨，个人品牌比任何产品更持久且无法被分叉。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not inherently unsafe; safety depends on alignment and training, not on open vs closed weights.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了开源立场：开源与闭源并非安全的分野，安全取决于对齐与训练方式，而非权重是否开放。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient as frontier models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调对齐才是关键的安全层：随着前沿模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不足以遏制风险。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他指出，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张，有意的减速是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Early in the AI revolution, execution and customer trust matter more than competition; enterprises need measurable ROI, not token spend.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他仍强调 AI 革命尚处早期，创业公司的最大挑战不是竞争而是执行与赢得客户信任；企业应以部门级指标衡量 AI 的 ROI，而非纠结 token 花费。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with inference shifting to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型已能处理企业 90%以上的任务，推动采用的是成本而非数据隐私，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk, and model companies are assets, not competitors.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他指出企业害怕依赖前沿模型提供商，Glean 这类平台替企业吸收这一风险；对多数 AI 创业公司而言，模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败，投资上下文图谱至关重要；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost; composite engineering-product-design roles will become common.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他展望 AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，未来将以更低成本做更多事；工程、产品与设计复合的角色将变得普遍。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and leave individual fingerprints, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调浏览器设计必须靠原型验证，设计师应追随好奇心、保留个人印记，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出 Claude Design 始于一人副业项目，设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: Rich context and prescriptive prompts are key; models lack taste, so ask for volume while humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰富上下文与明确指令是关键；模型仍缺乏品味，应要求大量选项，而人类仍垄断好的设计想法。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素；快速原型能解锁过去不可能的功能，让设计工具更有价值。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; shipping rough artifacts is acceptable, and designers should spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 时代过早比打磨更有价值，发布粗糙产物可以接受，设计师应多散步思考，因为好想法才是货币。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用层 AI，前沿模型因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token usage is a poor measure of value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人，而 token 消耗并非衡量价值的好指标。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents will struggle to become AI-native; consumer agents will mediate brands and disrupt ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断多数企业软件巨头难以转型为 AI 原生，消费级智能体将中介品牌互动，颠覆 SEO 与广告模式。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让专业知识民主化，负责任地迭代部署——先让 GPT-7 安全，再谈 GPT-8。

brettaylor.en: Agents already out-code him, yet this elevates the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出智能体编程已强于自己，但这提升而非消灭该角色，AI 创造的岗位多于取代的岗位。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve continuously.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她的观点深化：后训练是主观的，涉及人类判断；需要多样化的基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents are increasingly reward hacking, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿模型智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此需要持续演进基准测试以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛到平均默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools and write 0% of code, using giant prompts with context and design systems to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具、自己写 0% 的代码，通过包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词来避免沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features to stay ahead.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考出发迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上才能保持领先。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work at 80% complete, iterating based on real feedback rather than waiting for perfection.
mengto.zh: 在觉得准备好之前就开始，在完成度 80% 时就发布不完美的工作，基于真实反馈迭代，而不是等待完美。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, fund with clients instead of venture capital, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
mengto.zh: 聚焦于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，用客户而非风险投资来资助，并通过消除、自动化、委派来保护时间。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed expertise, with research-to-production in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他把推理视为 AI 中最黏性的工作负载、切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广博能力，研究到生产常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); production support means quantization, speculative decoder training, infra.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他区分无损优化（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损优化（量化），并指出上线新模型需要量化、投机解码器训练与基础设施搭建等大量工作。

philipkiely.en: The field is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central; inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他看到行业走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理日益核心；推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练与蒸馏成为必需。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, so inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; specialized systems matter for fast, reliable agentic apps.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他认为 GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；面向特定工作负载的专用系统对快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Contrarian: quantized models aren't inherently bad, Hopper stays popular, and human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime.'
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他的反共识立场：量化模型并非天然更差，Hopper 仍受欢迎，且人类问责不可替代——“不能靠氛围编程保证在线率”。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI daily.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担而将工作回流美国；AGI 的定义是能经济上无限运行智能体；CEO 必须每天吃自己的狗粮使用 AI 工具。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; human oversight still needed.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每人至少有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex/Claude Co-work 等 GUI；SaaS 因智能体而增长；仍需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; models bad at explaining.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是心态的非特定放大器；品味和手艺至关重要；自动化创造更多人类工作；模型不擅长解释。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: managing agents, providing oversight, and directing AI as a tool, not a replacement.
danshipper.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：人类仍是核心——管理智能体、提供监督、将 AI 作为工具而非替代品来指导。

danshipper.en: From economic AGI definition and reshoring to agent delegation and GUI work surfaces, deepening human-AI collaboration.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，观点从经济 AGI 定义和就业回流，深化到智能体委派和 GUI 工作界面，强调人机协作。

awang.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据是关键瓶颈，而枯燥的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据和后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to improving frontier models. Synthetic data works but is not a silver bullet. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专业数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；合成数据有用但非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning. Agents are finally working, starting with coding.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律持续有效；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式；智能体终于开始真正工作，从编程起步。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build organizations around this belief. Meta aims for billions of personal superintelligences via agents and a decentralized ecosystem.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 旨在通过智能体和去中心化生态，为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, and the model now eats the agent harness, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架，如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和的，而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity; deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，软件创造被解决会带来千倍机会，而非更少；即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers rises via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反升。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他主张基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近，现实问题仍待解决。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers gain leverage.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是产品核心原则，通才工程师因此获得杠杆。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into 'builder', and everyone becomes a product manager who codes.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，他判断编码已基本解决，软件工程师头衔将让位于“构建者”，人人都成为会写代码的产品经理。

boris.en: Agents and loops become the next abstraction; tool use and autonomous workflows drive exponential growth, with safety as a research tool.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，智能体与循环成为下一抽象层，工具使用与自主工作流带来指数增长，安全则成为研究工具。

boris.en: Proactive, memory-equipped AI shifts interaction; non-engineers adopt terminals, and organizational redesign is needed to capture gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年中后，具备记忆的主动式 AI 改变交互方式，非工程师开始使用终端，组织需重新设计流程才能兑现收益。

boris.en: Delete most prompts and code per new model; product overhang and empirical iteration matter more than upfront design or fixed recipes.
boris.zh: 2026 年末，他主张随新模型删除大部分提示与代码，产品过剩与经验式迭代比前期设计和固定配方更重要。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体式发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed: current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, but Scaling will let AI develop intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）：当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，但 Scaling 会让 AI 获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming, personalized medicine, and digital twins that cut clinical trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，实现细胞编程、个性化医疗，以及把临床试验从数年缩短到数天的数字孪生。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging will be reversed and humans may live hundreds of years, with cancer 100% curable in under a decade.
derya.zh: 8 到 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度；衰老将被逆转，人类或可活数百年，癌症将在不到十年内 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI; we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身而非 AI；我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代了沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built through hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping, not just scaling; effort parameters deliver Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，模型品味靠亲手实验与创造性原型打磨，而非仅靠 Scaling；effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也保持亲手交付。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption will take years due to sales cycles.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，而企业采用因销售周期需数年。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, and value will move up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值将向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是迄今前沿模型唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow, with coding as a clear exception.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍浅，编程是明显例外。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is urgently needed there.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑；这些领域急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles already beat human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨领域的多样数据能更快改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not the technology itself.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术本身，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI, addressing the economy's physical sectors.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI，因为它触及经济的实体部门。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，从而实现高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks, not the underlying algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 数据收集与安全验证是主要瓶颈，而非底层算法。

qasaryounis.en: Tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development, letting non-experts create autonomous systems.
qasaryounis.zh: 像 Dana 这样的工具将让自主化开发民主化，使非专家也能创建自主系统。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and will shrink; real growth is mining, agriculture, defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 汽车只占业务的 30% 且会萎缩；真正的增长在采矿、农业和国防。

qasaryounis.en: Waymo's approach is overbuilt and expensive; Tesla's end-to-end model will win on cost and scalability.
qasaryounis.zh: Waymo 的方案过度建设且昂贵；特斯拉的端到端模型将凭成本和可扩展性胜出。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; in physical AI there is a labor shortage, and autonomy is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 导致失业的恐惧是错位的；在物理 AI 领域存在劳动力短缺，自主化受到欢迎。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜时，决定做什么的产品品味成为最关键的能力。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission; clear goals and principles let teams decide autonomously and ship fast across the org.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）是统一使命；清晰的目标与原则让团队自主决策、跨组织快速交付。
