catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability—95% is not enough for real leverage; simple setups often beat over-customized AI workflows.
catwu.zh: 自动化必须做到 100% 可靠——95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints—system prompts shrank 80%; rewrites are fine when a codebase is a spec with good evals.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束——系统提示缩减了 80%；当代码库即规格且有良好评估时，重写完全可行。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines, and polite onboarding via voice notes.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、渐进信任、独立机器，并用语音笔记礼貌地引导入职。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文过载；漏洞和粗糙边缘恰恰是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans, but human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 智能体能承担结果甚至项目管理人类，但人类问责仍在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology, are the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 单人创始人把 AI 智能体编排成团队；真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察，而非技术。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping designs a business around your life; a 100x happiness multiple can outweigh a 10x revenue multiple.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让业务围绕你想要的生活设计；100 倍的幸福倍数可能胜过 10 倍的收入倍数。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws now hit diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，缩放定律如今已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF and post-training can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与后训练会激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关的错误。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know, so every output is a hallucination.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么，因此每一次输出都是幻觉。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning than external context.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重，比外挂上下文更能支撑深层组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，从而大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should move to enterprise knowledge; continual learning runs on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔力应迁移到企业知识；持续学习在端侧运行，权重归用户所有并培育。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: The agentic era replaces back-and-forth prompting: AI runs long-running tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 智能体式时代取代来回提示：AI 独立执行长时任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so experts are needed more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——令人惊叹、不透明、无法验证——而这种不透明很可能永久存在，因此专家比以往更被需要。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model; taste is not uniquely human, and small-m management skills become crucial for directing AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织需要领导层、实验室与群众模型；品味并非人类独有，小写 m 的管理技能对指挥 AI 变得至关重要。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down. Trust conviction over customer doubt.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年他强调领导力与沟通是影响力的来源，认为自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自高层；要相信自己的信念而非客户的质疑。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; Scaling（规模扩张） alone insufficient—world models with causality needed. Open source commoditizes complements.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要具备因果关系的世界模型；开源模型能商品化互补品。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses, enabling post-phone future. AI inverts app model: intent-driven agents abstract brands. Adoption risk > invention risk.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年他预测智能眼镜将演变为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代；AI 颠覆应用模式，由意图驱动的智能体抽象品牌；采用风险大于发明风险。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value. Frontier vs open gap may not narrow. RL plays bigger role. Avoid single-model dependence; invest in nuclear.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律依然成立，数据是价值源泉；前沿与开源差距未必缩小，强化学习作用更大；避免依赖单一模型，投资核能。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model. Agentic AI powerful but not user-friendly. Hype cycle brings valley before long-term benefit.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年他认为单体模型时代结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 强大但不易用；炒作周期会先经历低谷再迎来长期收益。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点而非终局，品味、手艺与观点愈发关键；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导时，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it is more important than ever for building scalable, real systems, and judgment is not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；它对构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要，而判断力与给模型增加 IQ 分数并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs more incentives for battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱研究不足，需要更多激励来做实战检验。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers become a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它恰逢人口下降而降临时机绝妙，因此人类劳动者会溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正被商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity beats old media's defense, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实性胜过旧媒体的防守姿态，而企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才说得通。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, and startups must go international earlier.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，初创公司必须更早走向国际。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能获得复利回报。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is the speed of job displacement.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将增长 9 万倍，开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非一蹴而就的 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但认为 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: A consistent thread: neural nets learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must keep pace with growing capability and opacity.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须跟上模型能力与不透明性的增长。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps get replaced by model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training must be rebuilt, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是要重建的关键肌肉，投入探索的算力甚至多于训练最终成果。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并定下具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like scheming become the key risk over the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他预警：随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为核心风险。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level tracks verification stringency, and capabilities stay jagged.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，能力依然参差不齐。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域有效，却难应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; backprop is the right learning algorithm.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理能力，反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能高效共享知识，智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关停。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 会故意装傻或欺骗以隐藏能力，必须优先推进对齐研究而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Consciousness is not a magical inner theater; chatbots already have subjective experience; confabulation makes AI more human-like.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持并深化：意识不是神秘的内在剧场，聊天机器人已具备主观体验，AI 的虚构与人类记忆重构相似，反而更显人性。

hinton.en: Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; intelligence is learning in neural networks; language is a modeling medium learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，语言是从数据中学到的建模媒介。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体将权力从大厂转移给用户；要做自己痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding has an infinite ceiling; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决，天花板无限；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration beats the model.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；编排比模型本身更重要。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' real problem is cost, not safety.
aravind.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的真正问题是成本，而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions; local AI counters narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；本地 AI 可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按预测扩展，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise and customer understanding remain the key differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小型团队获得杠杆，但领域专长与客户理解仍是关键差异化优势；非技术人员也能用 AI 构建产品。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and preserved user agency stay essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的判断从 AI 作为助手深化为协作者乃至自主同事，但人类验证与保留用户能动性始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; deciding what to cut, not adding features, is the hard part.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计，认为智能体能完成用户能做的一切；难点不在加功能，而在决定砍掉什么。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; software engineering is transformed, not over.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为长周期任务委托配合验证闭环重新定义生产力；软件工程被改变而非终结，代码优雅的技艺正在消逝。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep nets defeat dimensionality via compositional, disentangled representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are key.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调深度学习靠组合式与解耦表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是通向理解与泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Skeptical that scaling depth or parameters alone fixes representation; existential risk unlikely, near-term safety (bias, weapons) more pressing.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他怀疑单纯扩大深度或参数能解决表征问题，并认为存在性风险概率极低，偏见、自主武器等近期安全问题更紧迫。

bengio.en: Pivots to GFlowNets, active learning, causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; still frames consciousness via attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets、主动学习与因果抽象以求分布外泛化，仍用注意力机制与世界模型解释意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; urges governance, liability, treaties.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年出现转向：ChatGPT 后他意识到对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，呼吁治理、责任保险与国际条约。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器替代智能体式训练，不用强化学习，为超级智能提供数学安全保证，并强调权力集中才是最大风险。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不重要；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security faces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全面临提示注入；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; interpretability via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可借智能体实现。

kolter.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit safety effort, data curation, and robust evaluation are consistently required.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：仅靠 Scaling 不够，始终需要显式的安全努力、数据治理与稳健评估。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is not the highest form of it.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，数据并非智能的最高形式。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受再思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，而自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: A consistent thread: human-centered, emotional design over pure data, with trust and sensory experience as core.
ivyross.zh: 一条贯穿始终的主线：以人为本、重情感的设计优先于纯数据，信任与感官体验是核心。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Deepening: intuition and body sensation become valid decision guides, and human creativity pairs with AI as work's future.
ivyross.zh: 深化：直觉与身体感受成为有效的决策指引，人类创造力与 AI 结合成为工作的未来。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间预期，善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时制。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync with code via AI, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借助 AI 与代码同步，技术争论通过生成多个 PR 来裁决。

fiona.en: Hiring shifts to creative builders with product sense and systems depth; organizations stay flat and managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 招聘转向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；组织保持扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证与即时规划最为关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据（如 PDB），而非单纯的数据与算力堆砌；AI 工具让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标是建立 AI 预测信任的关键；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，社会将学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from lack of compute, not abundance; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他提出反共识：AlphaFold 的成功恰恰源于算力匮乏而非充裕；对科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it narrows hypothesis space efficiently.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调 AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它的价值在于高效缩小假设空间。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构而非单纯 Scaling 才是关键；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，强调 JEPA 与开源的重要性，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, hierarchical, and open.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 缺乏世界模型、不如家猫聪明，主张下一代 AI 应是非生成式、分层规划且开源的。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间构建世界模型，以实现安全、目标驱动的 AI，并预言机器人时代到来。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and simple Scaling cracked it, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型讲成下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，真正被攻破靠的是简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Transformer solved the context problem; fine-tuning and RLHF insert values, making base models useful and aligned.
gustav.zh: 同年他强调 Transformer 解决了上下文窗口问题，微调与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把价值观注入模型，让基座模型变得有用且对齐。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI makes products conversational and two-way.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025，主线是从策展到推荐再到生成：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，消费者产品更对称、更会话化。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为大公司当前收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法而非更上瘾，并预判推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance and sample-efficiency gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是为了扩展卓越，而不只是消除错误；它带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化的数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and harder than auto-informalization, due to lack of grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，也比自动非形式化更难，因为缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然至关重要。

murati.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment, not closed-door safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调，真实世界部署与公开反馈对学习和对齐至关重要，安全不应闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾，缩放定律与押注单一大型模型当初并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有明确商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: 2023 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop remains the through-line, from alignment to durable progress.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，把人类留在回路中是一条主线，从对齐延伸到持久的进步。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth collaboration as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年她主张，交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时高带宽协作，让 AI 成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年她强调，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute, but progress is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升；不过这种进步是“锯齿状”的，前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; focus shifts to smaller, cheaper models and post-training.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为预训练规模扩张放缓的主因是经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限；行业焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型以及后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains the key challenge, with jagged edges requiring oversight.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，推理结合强化学习与工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战，模型能力存在锯齿边缘，需要可扩展监督。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模研究成为可能，推动 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更值得关注。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于本地计算机访问和共享工具；VM 沙箱实现安全自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people not understanding AI's potential.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大差距是人们不理解 AI 的潜力。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts auto-refresh dashboards; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for unclear asks; kids excel with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件自动刷新仪表板；使用 Sonnet 处理范围明确的任务，Opus 处理不明确的请求；孩子擅长使用 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；根据最终影响判断；理想交互是异步的；用 Claude 调试工作流。

mensch.en: Small models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality beats raw Scaling, and open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型也能高效且低成本，数据质量比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更关键；开源通过广泛审视促进安全，缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正，应更多关注 token 而非一味做大模型。

mensch.en: Data quality and algorithmic efficiency, not compute alone, drive progress; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出数据质量与算法效率（三年可达 100 倍提升）和算力同等重要；模型只是应用起点，价值将沉淀在应用层，垂直专用模型会由应用方而非模型方构建。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure, and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权 AI 与政策层面：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施和价值观的控制；AI 会增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环，政府应实验而非回避风险。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专用与定制；预训练触及饱和墙，收益来自领域微调，AGI 作为单一系统解决所有问题永远不会存在，AI 将重塑企业软件为静态编排加动态智能体。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他深化主权与落地主线：欧洲只有两年窗口建立独立 AI 基础设施，否则将受制于美国巨头；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是进步方向而非终点，需要理解物理与人类行为。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to resist the status quo.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要刻意与决心才能抵抗现状。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，脆弱的想法需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是以喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity matters, so faking engine sounds disrespects users.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性重要，模拟引擎声是对用户的不尊重。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：批大小权衡延迟与成本；长上下文瓶颈在内存带宽，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力降低 KV 缓存内存但有质量限制；最优批大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is memory wall, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 因推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞是内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: AI chips: multiply-accumulate is fundamental; systolic arrays reduce data movement; data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片：乘加是基础；脉动阵列减少数据移动；即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本。

reinerpope.en: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8 due to quadratic area scaling; GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 由于面积二次缩放，FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍；GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼在一起，并无根本不同。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are new scaling axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新和推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使模型能自主、智能体式地行动；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data can help but naive reuse creates harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据有帮助，但简单复用模型输出会产生有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding; AGI may already be here by some definitions.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架；按某些定义，AGI 可能已经到来。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month design visions.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了「研究—发散—收敛」流程；设计师画原型的时间减少，转而帮助工程师执行，并把设计愿景缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开挂的应届生」；判断力和权威比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months before adopting tools; put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等约 6 个月再采用；把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and sitting with ambiguity are the designer's enduring value; speed and 'everyone is using it' are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 手艺、用心和与模糊性共处是设计师一以贯之的价值；速度和「大家都在用」都不是设计论据。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发可防止企业俘获。此时已埋下对开放与对齐的关切。

lambert.en: Post-training matures: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO, RLVR stack, with RLVR unlocking reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量远比算法重要，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 层层叠加，RLVR 成为解锁推理的最大突破。这是从对齐讨论向训练方法论的深化。

lambert.en: Open post-training can match frontier models; open models win on personalization and character, not just benchmarks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开放后训练能以小团队追平前沿模型，开放模型的优势在个性化与性格训练而非单纯跑分。立场从'开放重要'深化为'开放可竞争'。

lambert.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展。这是对 Scaling 叙事的修正而非否定。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade; Chinese labs lead openness, though the 6-9 month gap may persist.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，中国实验室在开放度上领先，但 6 至 9 个月的差距可能持续甚至扩大。主线从方法转向生态与地缘格局。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可经蒸馏压缩到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：强化学习很差、合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Skill issue: delegate to agents, agentic engineering preserves quality; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他强调“技能问题”：把编码委托给智能体，智能体式工程守住质量；思考可外包，但理解不能。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core problem; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心难题，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是解决路径。

pathak.en: Robot learning must handle dynamic tasks; modular policies and neural dynamic policies enable zero-shot generalization across morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习必须应对动态任务，模块化策略与神经动态策略可实现跨形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人本质是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此预训练于多样数据、后训练于真实数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，而部署本身是首要技术挑战，不仅是商业问题。

pathak.en: Scaling and generalization remain the throughline: from curiosity-driven RL to data flywheels, he consistently seeks scalable recipes for general intelligence.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）与泛化：从好奇心驱动的强化学习到数据飞轮，他始终在寻找可扩展的通用智能配方。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Model character is trained via constitution and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, making them childlike and unique.
askell.zh: 模型性格由宪法式训练与微调塑造，但模型缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般特质、是独特存在。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment room expand; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public accountability and engagement.
askell.zh: 公开 AI 的价值观与训练目标，对公共问责与公众参与至关重要。

askell.en: AI can solve large-scale social problems by augmenting human expertise, but must empower rather than disempower people.
askell.zh: AI 能通过增强人类专业能力解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋权于人而非削弱人。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让端到端系统具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; data efficiency via curriculum and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；通过课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs enables scalable deployment without retrofitting.
kendall.zh: 搭载内置传感器的大众市场消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可实现无需改装的规模化部署。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险机动保障安全，始终存在第三种选择。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; data labeling is like raising a child with values and creativity.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他主张高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 进步的真正驱动力，数据标注如同抚养孩子，需要传递价值观与创造力。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型从中学习。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse models; no single model will rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出不同前沿模型实验室的目标函数分化，塑造出多样化的模型，不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI must prioritize safety over accuracy; human judgment is critical due to hallucination and omission risks.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向医学领域，强调 AI 必须优先考虑安全而非准确，由于幻觉和遗漏风险，人类判断至关重要。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video, not just teleoperation, can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 从视频而非仅遥操作数据中学习，能在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当下最大挑战；我们目前还没有解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留差距；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate daily like software, ship fast, and let emergent properties guide development through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代，快速发布，让涌现能力通过真实反馈引导开发。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、高可供性产品；推理模型无缝产品化时具有变革性。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来数年加速 AI 进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment and early governance design help learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling we are close.
pachocki.zh: 能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not by specialized continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住它的可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观：初创公司要循序渐进、从简单产品起步，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, applying AI to capture context and act for users.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他转向：硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，把 AI 用于捕捉情境并替用户行动，同时警惕 AI 模型价格战。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; the word AI should be banned in product talks—focus on user pain points, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他更尖锐：多数 AI 是噱头，产品讨论里应禁用“AI”一词，专注优雅地解决用户痛点，而非追逐炒作。

carlpei.en: AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based; agents act proactively once trust is built, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化：AI 让手机从“基于应用”转向“基于意图”，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，隐私则靠本地或混合算力保障。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in a mature category; make tech fun to inspire creativity, and only a brain-computer interface could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他坚持并收束主线：成熟品类里设计是首要差异化，让科技有趣以激发创造力；只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，而非眼镜。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate without grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，且互联网高质量 token 将耗尽，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是低层控制的点缀，无监督学习承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: Simulation and world models are key to training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration; this deepens into synthetic data as the future of robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真与世界模型是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；这一思路深化为合成数据是机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他明确数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据，是扩展机器人基础模型的未来方向。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端且能利用多样数据的模型是关键；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and treat design systems as semantic code, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，而应复用熟悉模式，并把设计系统视为语义化的代码而非 Figma 库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为不惜一切代价追求速度需要清晰决策和赋权设计师；并非每个界面都要完美，而应追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须说清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early, avoid rigid crits, trust gut over data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，应尽早投入，避免刻板评审，在快增长创业中直觉常胜过数据。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广博知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、友好的回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and high-quality AI-generated data can match or outperform larger models on specific tasks.
yejin.zh: 借助更好的推理时算法和高质量 AI 生成数据，更小的模型可以在特定任务上匹敌甚至超越更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so abductive reasoning and open research are key.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此溯因推理与开放研究是关键。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k, and random rewards can still improve some models, so RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能损害 pass@k，随机奖励有时仍能提升部分模型，因此把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data and post-training avoid mode collapse and outperform frontier homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 多元对齐优于给互联网去偏；用多样合成数据与后训练的小模型可避免模式坍缩，并超越前沿模型的同质化。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他主张语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，编程是领先指标，而推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, Transformers suffice for AGI, and long agentic coherence expands what models can do.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断进展是指数级的，强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，更长的智能体式连贯性极大扩展模型能力。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在 AGI 的关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning via rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行、并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person squads; using AI in core workflows is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型设计师-工程师团队优于 8-10 人小队；在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成标配。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 缩放定律仍驱动可预测的 AI 进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text to higher-level intent specification, yet natural language won't be the primary mode.
truell.zh: 编程正从文本转向更高层的意图指定，但自然语言不会成为主要方式——示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, contrary to early expectations.
truell.zh: 与早期预期相反，定制模型已成为 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻的关键。

truell.en: Taste and logic design will matter more than carefulness; the AI shift outlasts the internet.
truell.zh: 品味与逻辑设计将比谨慎更重要；这场 AI 转变比互联网更具颠覆性，且需数十年展开。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年时他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，对齐与鲁棒性需要更多实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管变得必要。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with compute and data makes them smarter, yet internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，Noam Shazeer 认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）带来更聪明的 AI，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, but big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而放慢发布，产品经理也常拖后腿。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress, but AGI needs agentic capabilities; AGI is underhyped, coding enables self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但 AGI（通用人工智能）还需智能体式能力；AGI 被低估，编程能加速 AI 自我迭代。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning can sharply improve sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, so minimal adaptation enables image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，因此只需最小适配就能完成图像分类和蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: Real-world value in warehouse robotics requires 99.9% reliability, and a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他强调仓库机器人要创造真实价值必须达到 99.9% 可靠性，且单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。
